name: Hello Plugin
summary: A template: one command in the file menu that tells you how many items you chose.
description: Copy this folder, change the id (reverse domain, lowercase), the name and the publisher, then edit run.zsh. Run `vektor-plugin validate .` to check it, `vektor-plugin test . test/checks.json` to test it, and load it in Vektor with Developer mode on (Settings ▸ Plugins ▸ Load Plugin from Folder…).

items.label: Greeting
items.help: What the command says before the number of items.
